scope: MEASUREMENT_ONLY -- diagnostics, never mutates recorder/session behavior
canonical_semantic_losses_proof: See docs/audit_artifacts/v0_1_3_tsm_recorder_variance_audit.md Section 3 -- recorder.append() failures are caught inside SemanticRuntimeSession.finalize_call() and again inside Week2LLMGateway.finalize_semantic_invocation(), never reaching any of the 4 task-level callers (alpha_mapper.py, structure_extractor.py, evidence_stance_llm.py) whose semantic result (invocation.validated_output) was already fixed before the recorder/finalize call ran.

data_source_investigation.reason: SemanticRuntimeSession._degraded_reason_codes is a deduplicated list (a reason code is appended at most once per session) and is never written into llm_semantic_manifest.json (verified: no 'degraded_reason_codes' key in the manifest schema). The manifest's own 'complete' field does flip to False when ANY incomplete-flagged degradation occurs, but this is not recorder-specific (both the OLD and NEW TSM runs show complete=False for different reasons) and carries no count.
data_source_investigation.only_available_source: process-level launcher log (e.g. /tmp/comqutor_live_start.log), which is ephemeral and non-run-scoped -- never assumed canonical or durable by this module.
data_source_investigation.recorder_source_durability_default: EPHEMERAL_LOG_ONLY (when a log source is supplied) or UNAVAILABLE (when none is)

invariant_confirmed: SEMANTIC_RECORDER_APPEND_FAILED does not increment provider_failure_events, provider_final_orphans_total, claims_orphaned_by_provider_failure, or alphas_impacted_by_provider_failure -- confirmed via tests/test_recorder_health_diagnostics.py (test_recorder_events_do_not_become_provider_failures, test_separation_holds_even_when_provider_is_independently_degraded) and via direct comparison on the real new TSM run (247 recorder failures, impacted_alpha_ids independently confirmed unchanged at ['A101']).
